nuggets.text: Mason Mims completed 33 passes in his college debut against Campbell, breaking the Buccaneers' single-game record.
TJ Peyton ran for a career-high 121 yards and two touchdowns on only 11 carries against Tusculum.
Will Healy, the Buccaneers' coach, started at the Air Force Academy, then captained Richmond's 2008 FCS national title team.
Will Healy led Charlotte to its first-ever win over a Power 5 opponent, beating Duke.
Will Healy won the 2017 Eddie Robinson Award as the top FCS coach while leading Austin Peay.
The Buccaneers once played home games indoors, in an arena nicknamed the Mini-Dome, from 1977 to 2003.
The Buccaneers dropped football after 2003 and revived it in 2015 after a student government vote backed a fee increase.
The Buccaneers started out as the Teachers and did not adopt the Buccaneers name until 1935.
The Buccaneers' win over Tusculum renewed a series that had been dormant for more than 75 years.
Saturday is the Buccaneers' first-ever meeting with the Tar Heels and first game against an ACC team since 2002.
